messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High Alert Volume detected for service:redwood-inference/runtime — 38 alerts in 5m (noise spike). Pager: primary on-call alex.

alex: picking this up. seeing a flood of `rpc.latency.p95` and `runtime.queue.depth` alerts. paging spam from multiple teams.

mira: seeing same in dashboards — looks correlated with a config rollout to dedicated nodes ~09:12 UTC. possibly batch scheduler changes.

alex: good call. can someone pull the rollout changelist? @tanvi do you have the deploy details from the rollout bot?

tanvi: found: deploy id dpl-2026-04-04-378, rolled at 09:11 UTC to pool-dedicated-3. Rollout used new batching heuristic (auto-batch=v2) + parallelism bump.

ops-sre: attaching quick grep from logs: ```
2026-04-04T09:11:22Z runtime: batcher: increase parallelism to 16
2026-04-04T09:11:23Z cache: eviction started rate=230/s
2026-04-04T09:11:24Z rpc: accept loops slowed, p95 increased 620ms
``` 

alex: hypothesis: new batcher parallelism caused hot KV-cache churn -> evictions -> more backend RPCs -> latency -> alerts cascade. Immediate mitigation: rollback to previous batcher config or throttle parallelism. Can ops-sre trigger a canary rollback on pool-dedicated-3?

ops-sre: initiating rollback to auto-batch=v1 on pool-dedicated-3. commands run:
```
$ runtctl deploy rollback dpl-2026-04-04-378 --target pool-dedicated-3 --patch "auto-batch=v1"
``` 
Started 09:16:10 UTC; monitoring.

mira: dashboards: creating a short-lived aggregated view to track alert volume + cache evictions + rpc.p95. Added chart: Alert floods per 1m, KV eviction rate, rpc.p95, queue.depth.

incident-bot: Incident annotation: rollback started by ops-sre at 09:16:10 UTC. Link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/incidents/1759876543

alex: good. also we need to stop noisy alerts from paging everyone — put alert rule into maintenance mode or mute duplicates for 30m while we stabilize. I'll mute `alert:rpc.latency.p95` for the org.

tanvi: muting duplicate alerts (alerts-rule-id: ar-3129). Using alert manager silence: ```
$ amctl silence create --match alertname=rpc.latency.p95 --duration=30m --comment "muting noisy duplicates while rollout rollback in progress - oncall alex"
```
Silence active 09:18 UTC.

mira: after rollback, KV eviction rate dropped from 240/s to 8/s in ~3m. rpc.p95 back to baseline ~120ms. Alert noise reduced.

alex: nice. marking immediate mitigation completed at 09:22 UTC. Next: post-incident follow-ups — we must tune alerting to avoid cascades and add a dashboard and runbook notes.

ops-sre: agree. propose changes:
- change alert `rpc.latency.p95` to require sustained 5m > threshold for paging (currently 1m)
- add suppression rule: if `kv.eviction.rate` > X then suppress `rpc.latency` paging for non-production tiers
- create dedicated dashboard `runtime/eviction-impact` with annotations for deploys

tanvi: also suggest tagging alerts with `deployment_id` and `node_pool` to make rapid blast-radius assessment easier.

alex: please open a follow-up ticket and assign owners. I'll own the runbook update.

mira: created ticket RW-INC-3287: "Alert tuning + dashboard + runbook update — eviction-induced cascades". Link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/RW-3287. Assignees: alex(runbook), ops-sre(alerts), tanvi(dashboard).

incident-bot: Incident resolution checklist:
- [x] Mitigation applied (rollback) — 09:22 UTC
- [x] Noise muted — 09:18 UTC
- [x] Monitoring dashboards created — 09:19 UTC
- [x] Post-incident ticket created — RW-3287
- [ ] Root cause analysis draft
- [ ] Runbook update committed

alex: runbook update notes (draft):
- Add section "Eviction Cascade" under Runtime > Alerts.
- Document quick mitigation steps: Mute duplicate alert, rollback batcher changes, throttle parallelism, escalate to infra.
- Add playbook snippet with commands (amctl silence, runtctl deploy rollback) and links to dashboard and ticket.

alex: draft snippet:
```
# Eviction Cascade (run when runtime alert volume spike)
1. Pause noisy paging: amctl silence create --match alertname=rpc.latency.p95 --duration=30m --comment "oncall"
2. Check deploys in last 15m: runtctl deploy list --since 15m --pool <affected>
3. If deploy exists, rollback specific pool: runtctl deploy rollback <id> --target <pool> --patch "auto-batch=v1"
4. Watch KV eviction rate and rpc.p95 on runtime/eviction-impact dashboard
5. If stable, remove silence and schedule postmortem
```

mira: adding runbook links and diagrams. I'll commit the dashboard JSON to infra-dashboards repo and link from runbook. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-dashboards/pull/482

tanvi: for alert thresholds: proposing rule changes in alertmanager:
- rpc.latency.p95: alert if > 400ms sustained for 5m -> page
- rpc.latency.p95: alert if > 400ms for 1m -> warning (no page)
- add `suppress_if` for kv.eviction.rate > 100/s -> convert page to warning for non-prod

ops-sre: will draft alert rule PR and coordinate with owners for review. Aim to have change in monitoring by EOD.

alex: make sure runbook indicates ownership for these alerts: ops-sre owns `rpc.latency.*` alerts, runtime-engineering owns batching config, oncall owns initial mitigation.

tanvi: added owner annotations to ticket RW-3287.

incident-bot: Handoff reminder: on-call alex -> mira at 10:00 UTC. Please add any unresolved actions to RW-3287. Handoff at 09:40 UTC.

alex: handing off. Current status: service stable, noise muted, rollback on pool-dedicated-3 complete. Outstanding: alert rule PR (ops-sre), dashboard PR (mira), runbook commit (alex). Adding follow-up due date 2026-04-06.

mira: acknowledged handoff. I'll coordinate reviews for the dashboard PR and validate alert rule staging.

ops-sre: started alert rule PR: https://git.internal/redwood/monitoring/pull/1125 — includes 5m sustain change + suppression condition. Requesting review from runtime-engineering and SRE.

alex: thanks everyone. please ensure runbook `runtime/alerts.md` updated with the snippet and link to RW-3287. I'll leave a final note when runbook commit lands.

ci-bot: PR check passed for infra-dashboard PR #482 and monitoring PR #1125 (staging tests green).

mira: marking incident resolved in chat at 09:46 UTC. We'll run RCA and close after follow-ups done. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident resolved by alex at 09:46 UTC. Resolution link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/incidents/1759876543/postmortem

alex: postmortem owners: alex (write), ops-sre (root cause & alert changes), tanvi (dashboard), runtime-eng (deploy process fix). ETA for postmortem draft: 2026-04-07.

mira: adding retrospective note: consider adding circuit-breaker on KV cache churn to avoid sudden eviction storms. Ticketing separately RW-3290.

alex: closing thread. Thanks team. :pray:
